description: NaAlSiO₄ crystallizes in the trigonal R3c space group. Na is bonded in a hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.85 Å. Al is bonded to four O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.74 Å) and two longer (1.75 Å) Al-O bond lengths. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.64 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom.
